notes.subject: Jean reply — EVRPD referral / limited fit
notes.body: Aug. 28, 2026: Jean replied from evsr@evsr.org regarding Estes Park Autumn Gold. She said the event is primarily a music festival rather than a kids event and they do not have space for many kids activities. Their Rec Center already hosts a few games, and she is doubtful they could accommodate much more. Jean referred Adventure Zone to Estes Valley Recreation and Park District (EVRPD) at https://evrpd.com/ as a better contact/opportunity. Do not continue pushing Autumn Gold as a normal 2026 kids-entertainment lead; use the EVRPD referral for separate outreach/research instead.
